geometry_edits.rationale: Subtly stretch and flatten the slab to sharpen the horizontal datum before the courtyard carve.
Expand the void to improve public court legibility and active ground-space consequence.
Maintain the access-aligned opening so the court responds coherently to the road frontage.

graph_edits.rationale: Retarget the flat slab into a more articulated massing rule while preserving the existing courtyard ancestry.
Increase horizontal span slightly and thin the section to better support a neighborhood-building datum rather than a box.
Widen the public court/void so it reads more intentionally as usable shared space instead of a generic subtraction.
Keep the access-aligned opening toward the verified street edge to strengthen the ground threshold.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early-stage neighborhood-living mass: a compact horizontal bar wrapped into a U-like courtyard figure, with the road edge answered by an open side rather than a sealed frontage. It is legible in all four views and does not show obvious view-to-view collisions. The dominant gesture is readable, but the silhouette is somewhat generic and box-driven, with limited section ambition beyond a simple carved court. The void is the strongest element: it is public, central, and tied to the access edge, which aligns with the program's active ground threshold requirement. The roof/section is calm and plausible for mixed neighborhood use, though not especially expressive of upper hierarchy or daylight structure. Overall, this is program-fit and repairable, with precedent resonance strongest around courtyard-and-overhang community references.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise composition with a central void and upper bridge-like connection; good precedent for a public threshold and courtyard-led massing.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Aerial/campus scale is larger and more dispersed than this compact neighborhood parcel.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced low-rise campus logic with a strong shared court and layered setbacks; useful for balancing mass and open space.
Rectilinear mass with a large carved void and overhang; directly relevant to active ground-edge and public court articulation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More open and greenhouse-like than the candidate; facade transparency is not the point here.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Elongated mass with central atrium/void and a slightly folded roof line; useful for a horizontal neighborhood building with public center.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Spread-out courtyard composition with connected wings and terraced circulation; useful for preserving hierarchy while breaking the mass around a public void.
